content_text: Dear master Roger i would like to ask one thing.Why haven’t you joined social media? There have only been fake social profiles in your name. I even showed you an Instagram profile once and asked if it was you. Is there any particular reason why you haven’t joined social media, or is it because you don’t use it for privacy reasons? Do you at least use WhatsApp? Or telegram
